text: We audited AR-Kiv 1910-10819 version 2, claim by claim. Of 23 verdicts, 8 checked out, 4 were errors, 6 were unsupported, 3 were fitted after the observations, 1 was unfalsifiable as stated, and 1 lay outside this audit. The surviving physical core is narrow. If the universe has a preferred spin axis, clockwise and counterclockwise galaxy counts might differ. The paper supplies no trustworthy size for that difference.
